description: A constant hum of energy vibrates through gnome settlements, where gnomes laugh, tinker, and explore the wonders of the world.

features.name: Darkvision
features.tldr: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

features.name: Gnome Cunning
features.tldr: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

features.name: Gnomish Subrace
features.tldr: Choose a gnomish subrace such as Forest Gnome or Rock Gnome.

features.name: Inventive Spark
features.tldr: You gain extra versatility with tools or minor illusion magic depending on your heritage.

features.name: Elusive Magic
features.tldr: You can weave minor illusions to confound attackers or slip away from danger seamlessly.
